puzzles.name: Forest Barrier
puzzles.description: Break the Forest Barrier using the Forest Medallion's power. Navigate wind maze.
steps: Wind pushes player - use Hookshot to anchor

puzzles.name: Fire Barrier
puzzles.description: Break the Fire Barrier using the Fire Medallion. Light torches in sequence.
steps: Light 5 torches in order with Fire Arrows/Din's Fire
hints: Torch sequence shown on wall mural

puzzles.name: Water Barrier
puzzles.description: Break the Water Barrier using the Water Medallion. Water level puzzle with ice.
steps: Freeze waterfalls with Ice Arrows to climb

puzzles.name: Shadow Barrier
puzzles.description: Break the Shadow Barrier using the Shadow Medallion. Invisible maze with illusions.
steps: Lens of Truth essential - invisible paths

puzzles.name: Spirit Barrier
puzzles.description: Break the Spirit Barrier using the Spirit Medallion. Time-swap puzzle.

puzzles.name: Light Barrier
puzzles.description: Break the Light Barrier using the Light Medallion. Mirror puzzle with Light Arrows.
steps: Reflect light beams with Mirror Shield

puzzles.name: Tower Ascent - Stalfos Knights
puzzles.description: Ascend the tower fighting Stalfos knights. Parry and counter required.

puzzles.name: Ganondorf's Magical Barrier
puzzles.description: Break Ganondorf's barrier before final fight. Requires all 6 Medallions + Light Arrows.

phases.name: Ganondorf - Energy Tennis
phases.mechanic: Ganondorf floats, shoots energy balls - reflect with Master Sword
phases.puzzle: Perfect parry energy balls back. Zelda stuns with Light Arrow after 3-4 returns.
phases.vulnerability: Ball slows - time parry. Light Arrow stuns for sword combo.

phases.name: Ganondorf - Ground Shockwaves
phases.puzzle: Jump shockwaves, L-target, strike after teleport

phases.name: Ganon Transformation
phases.mechanic: Ganondorf transforms into Ganon. Master Sword knocked away.
phases.puzzle: Retrieve Master Sword while dodging Ganon

phases.name: Ganon - Tail Strike
phases.mechanic: Ganon rampages, tail is weak point
phases.puzzle: Megaton Hammer stun -> run behind -> Master Sword tail strike

phases.name: Final Seal
phases.mechanic: Zelda holds Ganon with Sages' power. Deliver final Master Sword strike.
phases.puzzle: Approach Ganon, Master Sword glows, final strike
